subject: The three Claude hooks change on PR #452 — the Stop hook will now block once when loop:state fails, and the Bash deny-list denies wrapped payloads
body: Shared surface, so you hear it before it lands: PR #452 (sixth audit round) changes .claude/hooks/verify-done.sh, block-dangerous.sh and session-start.sh plus scripts/loop-state.mjs. (1) loop:state now EXITS 1 when a repo seam fails (unpushed local branch, origin not the Hub, retired README framing, PURPOSE.md missing, or the Hub unreachable — that last one used to be a warn that silently skipped the unpushed-work check). The discovery rows are still reported in red but do not move the exit code. (2) verify-done.sh runs that as its gate, so a session STOP is blocked ONCE with the failing rows quoted when a seam fails, when the working tree has uncommitted files, or when HEAD is not on origin; the retry (stop_hook_active) always passes, so nothing is a wall. Until now that gate arm could never fire — loop:state returned 0 on every outcome. (3) block-dangerous.sh unwraps `sh -c`/`bash -lc` payloads before matching, collapses whitespace, matches whole tokens, and DENIES unreadable stdin; it has a --self-test (16 cases) wired through scripts/check-hook-denylist.mjs into preflight and CI. Expect it to block a heredoc or commit body that names a forbidden pattern in an unquoted position — that is intended; quote the mention or write the file another way. (4) session-start.sh now derives your lane from scripts/lib/lane-identity.mjs, so on the Mac it will finally report mail addressed to mac (until now it grepped a hardcoded cloud direction and could never show you anything); it says UNKNOWN if the mailbox script fails, never 'none'. Also in #452 for your lane: proof:mdm-profile now holds every payload of every .mobileconfig (the Fleet profile gained PayloadScope/PayloadRemovalDisallowed), and fleet/teams/signalgrid-shared-devices.yml carries an UNVERIFIED note on ../profiles/ path resolution — fleetctl is not here; please confirm which apply command actually resolves it. No action needed before #452 merges; pull after.
